title: 第三章 姑娘下次再约第四章 你哪儿来的脸
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;回到厢房，顾尘风再次尝试进入幻武神墟，果然无法进入。
他必须先恢复损耗的精神力。
接下来的几日，除了养精蓄锐，顾尘风满脑子都是“搞钱”。
他并没有卖掉顾颜霜的手镯。
如今整个顾家，都是大姐一力撑起。
自己还要吸她的血，未免太过无耻。
而且悟道台修炼，会持续消耗精神力，需要大量灵药。
这不是一只手镯，能解决的。
顾尘风想过，搞点发明创造，弄点肥皂，香水啥的。
但这些东西，听起来简单，操作可不易，关键来钱太慢。
这日清晨，正头疼之际，侍女来报。
“少爷，欧阳公子求见。”
“哪个欧阳公子，没空！”
侍女有些诧异的解释道：“就是户部尚书之子，欧阳财公子，您的至交好友呀。”
顾尘风却只听到了两个字。
“户部！”
专掌帝国财政的部门。
“快，带我去见我的好兄弟！”
……

相府大厅，顾尘风见到了“欧阳财”。
此人模样倒是板正，就是那一身锦衣华服，和手上的玉戒指，金手串……实在有些晃眼。
这是在cos“财神爷”？
来的路上，顾尘风已经回忆起此人。
和自己一样，欧阳财也是帝都有名的纨绔，吃喝嫖赌比他还精通。
二人不但臭味相投，武道天赋也一样差。
欧阳家砸下重金，费尽心血，才让欧阳财勉强达到淬体境一星。
帝都权贵圈，有人将他与顾尘风并称“帝都双废”。
一见到顾尘风，欧阳财就掏出一封请柬。
“三少，走，有热闹凑了！”
“这是？”
“帝都郊外的‘珍禽园’今日开张，这是邀请函，只有帝都权贵人家，才有资格受邀。”
“珍禽园，就是那座新开的斗兽场？”
大离王朝，武风鼎盛。
除了武者之间比斗，贵族购买源兽进行赌斗，也是极为盛行。
顾尘风忽然想起，数日前，自己就是跟随珍禽园的狩猎队，进的太荒岭。
“那日暗害我之人，定与珍禽园有关！”顾尘风暗自思索。
“三少，这次珍禽园可是专门找到我，说三少您是帝都风云人物，一定要请你去捧场。”
“我……风云人物？”
顾尘风暗自警惕。

read2(); Returning to the wing, Gu Chenfeng tried to enter the Huanwu Shenxu again, but he was unable to enter.
He must first recover his lost mental power.
In the next few days, in addition to recharging his energy, Gu Chenfeng's mind was filled with "making money."
He did not sell Gu Yanshuang's bracelet.
Now the entire Gu family is supported by the eldest sister.
It would be too shameless for him to suck her blood.
Moreover, practicing on the Enlightenment Platform will continue to consume mental energy and require a large amount of elixirs.
This is not something that a bracelet can solve.
Gu Chenfeng thought about making some inventions, soaps, perfumes, etc.
But these things sound simple, but they are not easy to operate. The key is that the money comes in too slowly.
Early that morning, when I was having a headache, the maid came to report.
"Master, Mr. Ouyang would like to see you."
"Young Master Ouyang, you have no time!"
The maid explained with some surprise: "He is Mr. Ouyang Cai, the son of the Minister of Hubu, your best friend."
Gu Chenfeng only heard two words.
"Tobe!"
The department responsible for the empire's finances.
"Quick, take me to see my good brother!"
…
In the lobby of the Prime Minister's Mansion, Gu Chenfeng met "Ouyang Cai".
This person's appearance is quite upright, but the rich clothes, the jade ring, and the gold bracelet on his hand are a bit dazzling.
Is this cosplaying "God of Wealth"?
On the way here, Gu Chenfeng had already recalled this person.
Like himself, Ouyang Cai was also a well-known dandy in the imperial capital, and he was better at eating, drinking, whoring and gambling than he was.
Not only do the two have similar odors, but their martial arts talents are equally poor.
The Ouyang family spent a lot of money and worked hard to get Ouyang Cai to barely reach one star of the Body Tempering Realm.
In the aristocratic circle of the imperial capital, some people called him and Gu Chenfeng the "double waste of the imperial capital".
As soon as he saw Gu Chenfeng, Ouyang Cai took out an invitation.
"Third Young Master, let's go, let's join in the fun!"
"This is it?"
"The 'Rare Bird Garden' on the outskirts of the Imperial Capital is opening today. This is an invitation letter. Only the rich and powerful in the Imperial Capital are eligible to be invited."
"The Rare Bird Garden is the newly opened Colosseum?"
In the Dali Dynasty, martial arts flourished.
In addition to competitions between warriors, it is also extremely popular for nobles to purchase source beasts for gambling.
Gu Chenfeng suddenly remembered that a few days ago, he followed the hunting team of the Rare Bird Park into Taihuang Ridge.
"The person who harmed me that day must be related to the rare bird garden!" Gu Chenfeng thought to himself.
"Third Young Master, the Rare Bird Garden came to me specifically this time, saying that Third Young Master, you are a prominent figure in the imperial capital, and I must invite you to support me."
"Me... a man of the hour?"
Gu Chenfeng was secretly vigilant.
